contests.title: Kechi Township — New township building
contests.scopeNote: Exact source-defined union of the13 precincts in the current official election notice; no Census township or city substitution.

provenance.quote: “Shall the Kechi Township, Kansas, be authorized to construct, equip and furnish a new township building for administrative use, equipment storage and maintenance, at an estimated total cost not to exceed $400,000; provided that all required funds for said project shall be derived solely from existing cash reserves currently held by the township and the proceeds from the sale of the existing township building, with zero dollars ($0.00) raised through the issuance of new bonds or any increase in the township's property tax levy, pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 80-104 et seq., as amended??”

measures.questionText: “Shall the Kechi Township, Kansas, be authorized to construct, equip and furnish a new township building for administrative use, equipment storage and maintenance, at an estimated total cost not to exceed $400,000; provided that all required funds for said project shall be derived solely from existing cash reserves currently held by the township and the proceeds from the sale of the existing township building, with zero dollars ($0.00) raised through the issuance of new bonds or any increase in the township's property tax levy, pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 80-104 et seq., as amended??”

provenance.quote: “Shall the Kechi Township, Kansas, be authorized to construct, equip and furnish a new township building for administrative use, equipment storage and maintenance, at an estimated total cost not to exceed $400,000; provided that all required funds for said project shall be derived solely from existing cash reserves currently held by the township and the proceeds from the sale of the existing township building, with zero dollars ($0.00) raised through the issuance of new bonds or any increase in the township's property tax levy, pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 80-104 et seq., as amended??”

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the township to build, furnish and equip an administrative, equipment-storage and maintenance building costing no more than $400,000. It would use existing cash reserves and proceeds from selling the current township building, with no new bonds or property-tax levy increase for this project.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the building project with these funding limits.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this building project.

sources.reviewedEvidence: Wherefore notice is hereby given pursuant to the provisions of K.S.A. 25-105 that the names and addresses of all persons specified in said notice from the Secretary of State, and in addition thereto, the names and addresses of all persons for whom nomination papers or declarations have been filed in the Election Commissioner’s office for which nomination is sought, are as follows, to-wit:

In compliance with the provisions of K.S.A. 19-3424 and K.S.A. 25-105, notice is hereby given that a
general election will be held on the 3rd day of November 2026. The following candidates and positions
will be on the ballot:

Select from the drop-down menu below to view a list of candidates in the primary or general election for national and state offices in table format.  The table view of the  candidate list is updated automatically as each candidate files valid petition forms or declaration of intention forms.
Shall the following be adopted?
State of Kansas Official General Election Ballot; Constitutional Amendment; November 3, 2026.
